profile.headline: software developer at banking industry
profile.summary: To obtain a full time or contract mid-level to senior position where I can leverage my experience with various software technologies.   Interested in telecommuting opportunities too.

positions.title: software developer
positions.description: Re-wrote visual basic 6.0 applications into vb.net .NET Framework 4.5, Visual Studio 2013, SQL Server 2012, service pack 2.

positions.title: software developer II
positions.description:
Environment:  Visual Studio 2012, .NET Framework 4.5.50709, SqlDbx 4.6, SQL Server 2012,  Sybase ASE 15.0.3
Re-wrote manual process as C# programs and stored procedures to read input from excel, populate tables in database, send out emails.  Supported editing/executing SQL scripts used by other departments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked at customer site on military radio adding features such as HAIPE key management and front panel modifications using existing software baseline encompassing SQLite, C++, Linux,  and CORBA software.

positions.title: software engineer
positions.description: Enhanced transportation system using C++ and Oracle 11.2g.  Wrote Oracle performance scripts to monitor memory usage(extents, redo log, shared pool, chained rows), sqlplus scripts to use IMPDP, EXPDP Oracle import/export commands, and pl/sql (cursors) scripts to verify goldengate replication.

positions.title: software test engineer contractor
positions.description: Enhanced  C# .NET desktop software used in testing and analyzing networking waveform performance in military radios to ensure it met requirements.  Communicated with radio hardware via ASCII commands and used regular expressions to filter text returned for information requested.

positions.title: M&T Bank, .NET software developer contractor
positions.description: Used SQL Server, stored procedures, C# in .NET framework to enhance/support new outsourced mobile phone application used on iPhones and Android.

positions.title: software test engineer contractor
positions.description: wrote scripts to simulate network traffic - load performance testing.  Enhanced c # windows applications for testing radios.

positions.title: software developer contractor
positions.description: Used SQL Server, Excel, Access data to generate statistics and reports used by various departments for managing mortgages in default and processing foreclosures for MHA government program.

positions.title: .NET software developer
positions.description: Used 2005, 2008 Visual Studio .NET (2.0, 3.5 Framework) for C #, Asp.net, vb.net, XML, gembase, sql, stored procedures, SQL Server and 10.2 Oracle for large manufacturing product inventory, shipment tracking.

positions.title: .NET Web developer contractor
positions.description: Used Asp.net, vb.net, html, javascript, informix, sql, stored procedures to enhance existing web application in/for large inventory and procurement system used by buyers and store managers to determine status of product availability.

positions.title: .NET software engineer
positions.description: Used xml, VB.NET 2003 and 2005, ADO.NET (for SQL Server 2000 and ODBC for  non-Microsoft databases), ASP.NET, MySQL, Microsoft Sql Server 2000 and 2005, some CAD, and some older systems using Progress database.    Full software life cycle.  Applications were to support the web-based application (reports, sales, quotes, inventory) used by dealers throughout US to sell the company's cranes.    Also wrote vb.net 2005 code for similar application used in company's China manufacturing plant.

positions.title: consulting software engineer
positions.description:
1/1999 - 8/1999 Configuration management team member using ClearCase 
8/1999 - 3/2000 Unix shell scripting software developer
3/2000 - 3/2004 embedded C, Unix, Lynx, Linux software developer

Senior software engineer for Network Scanning feature on mid-sized black/white and color copiers. Developed and maintained embedded code which interfaced with the other processors.  Wrote code to  file electronic images to filing locations(server, directory, username, password) and accept/validate/process the parameters the walk-up user selected for their image/document to be scanned such as image attributes, document format, filing policy, metadata information, user id validation, etc. Full software life cycle including requirements, design, documentation, unit testing, test clients, integration, maintenance, support.   Attended regular meetings with systems engineers, team meetings, code reviews.  System level software integration and troubleshooting.   Participated in software and system level reliability qualification tests.  The code was written in C using IPC message queues, interrupts, application procedure interface (proprietary RPC calls), shared memory, shared files, and both Lynx, and Linux. For software control/configuration management, used clearDDTS during first 2 years and CVS during last 2 years.

positions.title: Software Engineering Contractor
positions.description: Supported & maintained applications used in circuit board manufacturing process. Minor UNIX system administration. Developed UNIX scripts, which included SED, AWK, and embedded SQL. Re-wrote FORTRAN programs in C. (ORACLE, 4GL).
